```{r}
#| label: data-prep-obs



# 


  

distinct(d_full, analyte)

d_nomiss <- d_full |> 
  filter(!is.na(value_std)) 

# Using complete cases for T2 and T4
dat <- d_nomiss |> 
 
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4")) |> 
  filter(.by = participant, 
         sum(!is.na(value_std)) == 16) |> 
  
  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         participant = dense_rank(participant), 
         treat_seq = dense_rank(treat) ) |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value_std) |> 
  arrange(participant, type)





d <- list(P = dat$participant, 
          y = dat$T4, 
          pre = dat$T1, 
          type = dat$type, 
          K = length(unique(dat$type)),
          N_P = length(unique(dat$participant)),
          N_TX = 2,
          treat = dat$treat_seq, 
          N = nrow(dat))





```



```{r}



```



```{r}
#| label: fig-s1-synth
#| fig-cap: "Assessing model S1 with synthetic data. The model captures the simulated effect (in type 1 and 2) with no preference between treatment groups. Densities are contrats treatment 2 - treatment 1 divided by the residual standard deviation."

# Compiling the model
s1 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s1.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s1.exe")


dl1 <- d1$dl_compl_single
dl1$prior_only <- 0

fit_wrap(s1, DATA = dl1, fit = "fit.s1.synth")

draws.synth1 <- fit.s1.synth$draws(format = "df")

p1 <- draws.synth1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("alpha")) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(treat = paste0("treat", treat)) |> 

  
  ggplot(aes(value, color = treat)) + geom_line(stat = "density") + 
  facet_wrap(~ type)


alphas_contr <- draws.synth1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("alpha")) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(treat = paste0("treat", treat)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = treat, values_from = value) |> 
  mutate(contr = treat2 - treat1) 


# True effects
true_es <- data.frame(type = as.character(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)), 
                      es = c(0.5, -0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))


draws.synth1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("sigma")) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type")) |> 
  mutate(sigma = value) |> 
  select(-param, -value) |> 
  inner_join(alphas_contr) |> 
  mutate(es = contr / sigma, 
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(es)) + geom_line(stat = "density") + 
  
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = es), 
             data = true_es) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free") +
  alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = "Effect size [(&alpha;~2~ - &alpha;~1~)/&sigma;]", 
       y = "") + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_markdown())
  
 


```

```{r}
# Full posterior
d$prior_only <- 0
fit_wrap(s1, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s1p", refit = TRUE)
```

Sampling from the posterior using observed data gives us satisfactory performance metrics (@fig-s1-modelperformance). The posterior predictive check (@fig-s1-posteriorpredict) indicate that the model capture the general pattern of the observed data. 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics from Model s1."
#| label: fig-s1-modelperformance


# Model performance
s1_sum <- fit.s1p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- s1_sum |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- s1_sum |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)




draws.s1 <- fit.s1p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.s1 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value")



p1 / p2


```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of Model s1 using data from T4."
#| label: fig-s1-posteriorpredict


# Extract log_lik
log_lik.s1 <- fit.s1$draws("log_lik_part", format = "matrix") |> 
  loo::loo(cores = 12)


draws.s1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1, .draw %in% 1:50) |> 
  select(starts_with("y_rep"), .chain, .draw) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |> 

  
  mutate(type = rep(d$type, 50), 
         treat = rep(d$treat, 50), 
         treat = if_else(treat == 1, "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  
  
  inner_join(dat |> 
  distinct(type, analyte)) |> 

  ggplot(aes(value, group = paste(.draw,treat), 
             color = as.factor(treat))) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density", 
            aes(), 
            alpha = 0.2)  +
  geom_line(stat = "density", 
            # Sort data category for treat
            data = data.frame(y = d$y, 
                              type = d$type, 
                              treat = d$treat) |> 
              mutate(treat = if_else(treat == 1, "Placebo", "N-3")), 
            
               aes(y, group = treat, color = as.factor(treat)), 
            linewidth = 1.5)  +
  facet_wrap(~ analyte) + 
  alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  labs(y = "Density", 
       x = "Predicted/Observed values", 
       color = "Treatment") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) 


```



Prior predictive simulations give the expected association between pre- and post-treatment scores (@fig-s2-priorpredict). Using synthetic data confirms that the model captures the same effect as in the simpler model S1 (@fig-s2-synth).

Sampling from the posterior gives us satisfactory statistics for convergence (@fig-s2-modelperformance). Three samples had Pareto k estimates above 0.7, indicating influential data points.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check of Model s2."
#| label: fig-s2-priorpredict


### Model 2

# Compiling the model
s2 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s2.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s2.exe")



# For prior predictive checking
d$prior_only <- 1

fit_wrap(s2, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s2")


draws.s2 <- fit.s2$draws(format = "df")


draws.s2 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"),
         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 

  mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type), 
         treat = gsub("\\]", "", treat)) |> 
  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.4)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(placebo = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         omega = rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = placebo:omega, 
               names_to = "treat") |> 

  summarise(.by = c(pre, treat, type), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 
  
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("placebo", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(type ~ treat) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2,2)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-6,6)) + 
  labs(y = "Prior predictive (90% prediction intervals)", 
       x = "Pre-intervention scores") +
  alpha_theme()
```

```{r}
# Full posterior
d$prior_only <- 0

fit_wrap(s2, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s2p")

# Log lik comp
log_lik.s2 <- fit.s2p$draws("log_lik_part", format = "matrix") |>
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics from Model s2."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-s2-modelperformance
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false



## Pareto K diagnostics
p3 <- data.frame(
  P = d$P,
  y = d$y, 
  type = d$type, 
  pre = d$pre, 
  paretok = rep(log_lik.s2$diagnostics$pareto_k, each = 8)) |> 
  
  
  mutate(pareto_flag = if_else(paretok > 0.7, "Bad (> 0.7)", "Good (< 0.7)")) |> 
  inner_join(
    dat |> 
      distinct(type, analyte)
  ) |> 

  

  ggplot(aes(pre, y, color = pareto_flag)) + geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ analyte)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale[c(2, 1)]) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-intervention scores (std)", 
       y = "Post-intervention scores (std)", 
       color = "Pareto k diagnostic values") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.85, 0.15))
  


# Model performance
s2_sum <- fit.s2p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- s2_sum |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- s2_sum |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)




draws.s2 <- fit.s2p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.s2 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value")



(p1 / p2) | p3


```

Posterior predictions indicate that the model captures the observed data patterns (@fig-s2-posteriorpredict). Plotting the observed data on model predictions using the pre-intervention score also indicate reasonable fit (@fig-s2-posteriorpredict2).

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of Model s2 using data from T4."
```
```{r}
#| label: fig-s2-posteriorpredict2




dat_plot <- data.frame(
  treat = d$treat, 
  pre = d$pre, 
  y = d$y, 
  type = d$type) |> 
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("1", "2"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3")))
  




draws.s2 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  
  filter(.iteration %in% 1:2000) |> 
  
  select(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"),
         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 

  mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type), 
         treat = gsub("\\]", "", treat)) |> 
  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(placebo_pred = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         omega_pred = rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         placebo_mu = alpha1 + beta * pre, 
         omega_mu = alpha2 + beta * pre) |> 
 

  pivot_longer(cols = placebo_pred:omega_mu, 
               names_to = "treat") |> 
  separate(treat, into = c("treat", "pred")) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(pre, treat, type, pred), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 

  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("placebo", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             group = pred)) + 
  
  
  geom_point(data = dat_plot, 
             aes(pre, y, 
                 ymin = NULL, 
                 ymax = NULL, 
                 group = NULL), 
             alpha = 0.2) +
  
  
  
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(type ~ treat) +
  labs(y = "Posterior predicted mean (90% PI prediction and &mu; interval)", 
       x = "Pre-intervention scores") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown())

```




```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| output: false


# Model 3 -- Missing data included 
dat <- d_full |> 
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4")) |> 

  
  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         participant = dense_rank(participant), 
         treat_seq = dense_rank(treat), 
         miss = if_else(is.na(value_std), 0, 1), 
         value_std = if_else(is.na(value_std), -999, value_std)) |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = c(value_std, miss)) |> 
  mutate(age = (age - mean(age)) / sd(age), 
         sex = if_else(sex == "m", 1, 2)) |> 
  
  
  
  select(y_obs = value_std_T4, 
         pre_obs = value_std_T1, 
         y_miss = miss_T4, 
         pre_miss = miss_T1, 
         P = participant, 
         age, 
         sex,
         type, 
         treat = treat_seq, 
         analyte) 




d <- list(
  N = nrow(dat), 
  N_P = length(unique(dat$P)),
  K = length(unique(dat$type)),
  y_obs = dat$y_obs, 
  pre_obs = dat$pre_obs, 
  y_miss = dat$y_miss,
  pre_miss = dat$pre_miss, 
  type = dat$type, 
  treat = dat$treat, 
  P = dat$P, 
  prior_only = 1
)



s3 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s3.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s3.exe")

fit_wrap(s3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s3")

```

Next we are fitting the model with synthetic data, including rows with missing data. Again, the model captures the simulated treatment effects (@fig-s3-synth).


```{r}
#| label: fig-s3-synth
#| fig-cap: "Assessing model S3 with synthetic data. The model captures the simulated effect (in type 1 and 2) with no preference between treatment groups. Densities are contrats treatment 2 - treatment 1 divided by the residual standard deviation."

s3 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s3.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s3.exe")



dl1_itt <- d1$dl_itt_single
dl1_itt$prior_only <- 0


fit_wrap(s3, DATA = dl1_itt, fit = "fit.s3.synth")


draws.synth3 <- fit.s3.synth$draws(format = "df")


p1 <- draws.synth3 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("alpha")) |> 


  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(treat = paste0("treat", treat)) |> 

  
  ggplot(aes(value, color = treat)) + geom_line(stat = "density") + 
  facet_wrap(~ type)


alphas_contr <- draws.synth3 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("alpha")) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(treat = paste0("treat", treat)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = treat, values_from = value) |> 
  mutate(contr = treat2 - treat1) 


# True effects
true_es <- data.frame(type = as.character(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)), 
                      es = c(0.5, -0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))


draws.synth3 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration,  starts_with("sigma")) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "type")) |> 
  mutate(sigma = value) |> 
  select(-param, -value) |> 
  inner_join(alphas_contr) |> 
  mutate(es = contr / sigma, 
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(es)) + geom_line(stat = "density") + 
  
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = es), 
             data = true_es) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free") +
  alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = "Effect size [(&alpha;~2~ - &alpha;~1~)/&sigma;]", 
       y = "") + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_markdown())
  
 




```



```{r}
# Full posterior s3 

d$prior_only <- 0

fit_wrap(s3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s3p", refit = TRUE)

draws.s3 <- fit.s3p$draws(format = "df")

```


Sampling from the full posterior indicated good effective sample sizes and R-hat values (@fig-s3-modelperformance). Posterior predictions also indicated reasonable agreement between observed data and model predictions (@fig-s3-posteriorpredict and @fig-s3-posteriorpredict2).

```{r}
  summarise(.by = name,

            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |>
  mutate(type = dat$type,

         P = dat$P,
         y_obs = dat$y_obs,
         pre_obs = dat$pre_obs) |>
  filter(y_obs > -900) |>
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of Model s3 using data from T4."
#| label: fig-s3-posteriorpredict2


dat_plot <- data.frame(
  treat = d$treat, 
  pre = d$pre_obs, 
  y = d$y_obs, 
  type = d$type) |> 
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("1", "2"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  filter(y > -900, 
         pre > -900) 
  

draws.s3 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  
  filter(.iteration %in% 1:200) |> 
  
  select(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"),
         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 

  mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type), 
         treat = gsub("\\]", "", treat)) |> 
  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(placebo_pred = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         omega_pred = rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         placebo_mu = alpha1 + beta * pre, 
         omega_mu = alpha2 + beta * pre) |> 
 

  pivot_longer(cols = placebo_pred:omega_mu, 
               names_to = "treat") |> 
  separate(treat, into = c("treat", "pred")) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(pre, treat, type, pred), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 

  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("placebo", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             group = pred)) + 
  
  
  geom_point(data = dat_plot, 
             aes(pre, y, 
                 ymin = NULL, 
                 ymax = NULL, 
                 group = NULL), 
             alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(type ~ treat) +
  labs(y = "Posterior predictive mean (90% PI prediction and &mu; interval)", 
       x = "Pre-intervention scores") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown())
```

```{r}
draws.s4 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1, 
         .iteration %in% 1:1000) |> 
  select(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"),
         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 

  mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type), 
         treat = gsub("\\]", "", treat)) |> 
  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.4)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(male_placebo = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre + beta_sex * -0.5, sigma), 
         male_omega = rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre + beta_sex * -0.5, sigma), 
         female_placebo = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre + beta_sex * 0.5, sigma), 
         female_omega = rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre + beta_sex * 0.5, sigma)
         
         ) |> 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = male_placebo:female_omega, 
               names_to = "treat") |> 
  separate(treat, into = c("sex", "treat")) |> 


  summarise(.by = c(pre, sex,treat, type), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05),

  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("placebo", "omega"),

       x = "Pre-intervention scores") +
  alpha_theme()
```

Prior predictive checks confirmed that the model now predicts for males and females over all type and treatment combinations (@fig-s4-priorpredict).

```{r}
## Model 5 and 6 --- Including both time-point ##
dat <- d_full |> 
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2","T4")) |> 
  

  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         participant = dense_rank(participant), 
         treat_seq = dense_rank(treat), 
         value_std = if_else(is.na(value_std), -999, value_std)) |> 

    select(-value) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = c(value_std)) |> 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = T2:T4, 
               names_to = "time",
               values_to = "y_obs") |> 
  rename(pre_obs = T1) |> 
  

  
  mutate(time = if_else(time == "T2", 1, 2), 
         sex = if_else(sex == "m", -0.5, 0.5), 
         y_miss = if_else(y_obs == -999, 0, 1), 
         pre_miss= if_else(pre_obs == -999, 0, 1)) |> 

  select(y_obs, 
         pre_obs, 
         y_miss, 
         pre_miss, 
         P = participant, 
         sex,
         type,
         type,
         time,
         treat = treat_seq) |> 

  arrange(P, time, type) 



d <- list(
  N = nrow(dat), 
  N_P = length(unique(dat$P)),
  K = length(unique(dat$type)),
  y_obs = dat$y_obs, 
  pre_obs = dat$pre_obs, 
  y_miss = dat$y_miss,
  pre_miss = dat$pre_miss, 
  type = dat$type, 
  treat = dat$treat, 
  P = dat$P, 
  prior_only = 1,
  # Adding sex and time to data structure
  time = dat$time,
  sex = dat$sex
)


s5 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s5.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s5.exe")

s6 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s6a.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s6.exe")


# Fit the prior model
d$prior_only <- 1
fit_wrap(s5, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s5")
fit_wrap(s6, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s6", refit = TRUE)

draws.s5 <- fit.s5$draws(format = "df")
draws.s6 <- fit.s6$draws(format = "df")


# Uniform treatment effect over all 
draws.s6 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(
         starts_with("alpha"), 

         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer( starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "time", "type", "treat")) |> 
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat, type), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(type, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, color = treat, 
             group = treat)) + 
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~time, ncol = 1)



## Fitting with simulated data 

dl1_itt <- d1$dl_itt
dl1_itt$sex <- dl1_itt$sex - 1.5
dl1_itt$prior_only <- 0

fit_wrap(s5, DATA = dl1_itt, fit = "fit.s5synth")
fit_wrap(s6, DATA = dl1_itt, fit = "fit.s6synth")

draws.s5 <- fit.s5synth$draws(format = "df")
draws.s6 <- fit.s6synth$draws(format = "df")

bind_rows(
draws.s6 |> 
   filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(
         starts_with("alpha"), 

         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer( starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "time", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(model = "Model S6"), 
draws.s5 |> 
   filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(
         starts_with("alpha"), 

         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer( starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "time", "type", "treat")) |> 
  mutate(model = "Model S5")) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(time, treat, type, model), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(type, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, color = paste(treat,model), 
          shape = model)) + 
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~time, ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
## Comparing treatments


bind_rows(

         ) |> 

    pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 
    mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type),

  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 

  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(placebo_pred = rnorm(1, alpha1 , sigma), 
         omega_pred = rnorm(1,   alpha2 , sigma), 
         placebo_mu = alpha1 , 
         omega_mu = alpha2 ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = placebo_pred:omega_mu, 
               names_to = "treat") |> 
  separate(treat, into = c("treat", "pred")) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(treat, type, pred), 
            m = mean(value),

  filter(pred == "mu") |> 
    mutate(model = "m3"),

  separate(treat, into = c("treat", "pred")) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(treat, type, pred),
```
